args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

Nightly build failed because tests/test_money.py expects banker's
rounding but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Import and use
ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-values round to the nearest even cent
(2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66), matching the docstring.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` — despite the docstring already claiming banker's rounding.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`, so half-values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.675 → 2.68`, `2.665 → 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

Fixes the nightly build failure.
